goalTree.intent: Autonomous tracking of building tool prices across Canadian hardware retailers with automated scraping, price change analytics, and zero-cost hosting.
objectives: Extract live prices and stock statuses from major Canadian retailers (Home Depot CA, KMS Tools, Atlas Machinery, Rona, Federated Tool)
Maintain historical price audit records in PostgreSQL database via Prisma
Display real-time CAD metrics, price drop percentages, and interactive charts
Execute scheduled cron updates without triggering retailer bot blocks
constraints: 100% Free tier architecture (Vercel + Supabase + open DOM scrapers)
Strict rate limiting per store domain (minimum 2s jitter delay)
Zero human handoff during build and verification pipeline
success_criteria: Next.js production build exits with code 0
URL paste accurately detects retailer and persists to database
Interactive recharts visualizes at least 3 historical price points
Cron endpoint /api/cron/sync executes without unhandled hanging promises
failure_modes: DOM structure changes at retailer causing scraper null pointer exception
Missing database credentials on new environments
Prerendering bailouts during Next.js build due to unhandled dynamic headers
